nav.home.tip: Dashboard: sync progress and node stats
common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
err.auth: florestad rejected the credentials. Check FLORESTA_DATADIR and FLORESTA_NETWORK (cookie) or FLORESTA_RPC_USER / FLORESTA_RPC_PASSWORD.
err.timeout: The node took too long to answer.
err.notAllowed: This RPC method is not allowed by the UI server.
char.girl.name: Forest Girl
talk.loading: Hello! Let me peek at the node…
talk.offline: Zzz… The node isn't answering. Is florestad running? I'll keep checking every 5 seconds.
talk.auth: The node won't let us in… The cookie might be in another folder or network.
talk.few_utreexo: The forest stopped growing… Only {n} friend(s) can share Utreexo proofs, and we need at least 2. Shall we check on the party?
talk.stalled: The forest stopped growing… Lv. {height} hasn't changed for a while. Shall we check on the party?
talk.syncing: We're catching up! {remaining} more blocks to go. Let's keep growing the forest!
talk.synced: All caught up! The forest is fresh at Lv. {height}.
dash.offline.title: Cannot connect to the node
dash.offline.body: florestad is not answering. The UI keeps trying every 5 seconds and will recover by itself.
dash.stall.title: The sync may have stopped
dash.stall.fewUtreexo: Only {n} Utreexo-capable peer(s) are connected. Floresta needs at least {min} to make progress.
dash.stall.noProgress: The validated height has not changed for over 10 minutes.
dash.uptime.tip: How long florestad has been running (uptime)
dash.latest.tip: Best block hash (bestblockhash) and its time
dash.stage.caption: {n} Utreexo trees (roots)
peers.lead: Your party is the peers florestad is connected to. Utreexo-capable peers send the proofs Floresta needs, so it needs at least two of them.
peers.summary.note: Utreexo peers are highlighted in green below.
peers.warn.title: Not enough Utreexo friends
peers.invite.label: Peer address (ip:port)
peers.invite.hint: Runs addnode <ip:port> add. IPv4, [IPv6]:port or a bare IP.
peers.invite.invalid: Enter an IP address, optionally with a port, like 203.0.113.7:8333 or [2001:db8::1]:8333.
peers.invite.confirmBody: florestad will add the peer to its list and try to connect now.
peers.invite.sent: Invitation sent to {addr}. It appears below once the handshake starts.
peers.disconnect.title: Disconnect this peer?
peers.disconnect.body: florestad will drop the connection to {addr}. It may connect to other peers instead.
block.lead: A simple block explorer. Headers are stored locally and show up instantly; Floresta does not keep block bodies, so they are fetched from peers on demand.
block.search.label: Height or block hash
block.search.invalid: Enter a block height (a number) or a 64-character block hash.
block.fetching.note: Floresta does not store blocks, so getblock asks the network. This can take up to 30 seconds.
block.fetchFailed: Could not fetch the block body
block.fetchFailed.body: The peers did not deliver it in time. The header above is still valid.
block.txids.note: Floresta only looks up transactions that belong to your watch-only wallet, so the IDs are listed without links.
